about.description:
OpenMC is a community-developed Monte Carlo neutron and photon transport
simulation code. It is capable of performing fixed source, k-eigenvalue, and
subcritical multiplication calculations on models built using either a
constructive solid geometry or CAD representation. OpenMC supports both
continuous-energy and multigroup transport. The continuous-energy particle
interaction data is based on a native HDF5 format that can be generated from
ACE files produced by NJOY. Parallelism is enabled via a hybrid MPI and
OpenMP programming model.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.16.0"
  build_number: 1

package:
  name: "openmc"
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/openmc-dev/openmc/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: cfdf10f8dc66e652668dbc94501d5ed99b3dfecabc11cf91989a29ba7984654f
  patches:
    # TODO: Remove when updating past v0.16.0, as the vendored git submodules
    # are removed upstream
    - remove-check-for-vendored-git-submodules.patch

build:
  # add build string so packages can depend on
  # dagmc or nodagmc variants explicitly:
  # `openmc * nodagmc_*` for openmc without dagmc
  # `openmc * dagmc_*` for openmc with dagmc
  # mpi or nompi variants explicitly:
  # `openmc * mpi_mpich_*` for mpich
  # `openmc * mpi_*` for any mpi
  # `openmc * nompi_*` for no mpi
  # rattler-build exposes the resolved build.number as build_number when
  # rendering build.string, so only apply the offset here
  number: ${{ build_number | int + 100 if dagmc_variant == "dagmc" else build_number }}
  # c.f. https://rattler-build.prefix.dev/latest/reference/jinja/#extra-filters-for-recipes
  string: ${{ dagmc_variant }}_${{ mpi_prefix }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  variant:
    # prefer 'dagmc' over other variants
    down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 0 if dagmc_variant == "dagmc" else 1 }}
  skip:
    - win
    - match(python, "<3.12")
  prefix_detection:
    ignore_binary_files: true

requirements:
  build:
    - cmake
    - make
    - pkg-config
    - setuptools_scm
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then: mpi [build=${{ mpi }}]
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
  host:
    # Repeat of requirements with no constraint and with build variant are to
    # pick up global pinning (from no constraint)
    - if: dagmc_variant == "dagmc"
      then:
        - dagmc
        - dagmc-${{ mpi }}
        # The installed openmc/dagmc.h header includes DagMC.hpp, which exposes
        # Eigen types via MOAB (Matrix3.hpp), so depend on eigen-abi-devel to
        # get the eigen-abi ABI marker run export. The Eigen 3 pin matching dagmc
        # is set in variants.yaml.
        # c.f. https://github.com/conda-forge/eigen-feedstock/blob/main/recipe/README.md
        # TODO: Move to Eigen v5
        - eigen-abi-devel
    - fmt
    - hdf5
    - hdf5 [build=${{ mpi_prefix }}_*]
    - libpng
    # libopenmc links against libomp directly
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - pugixml
    - git
    - setuptools
    - setuptools_scm
    - pip
    - numpy
    - matplotlib-base
    - h5py [build=${{ mpi_prefix }}_*]
    - python
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then: mpi [build=${{ mpi }}]
  run:
    - if: dagmc_variant == "dagmc"
      then:
        - dagmc
        - dagmc-${{ mpi }}
    - hdf5
    - hdf5 * [build=${{ mpi_prefix }}_*]
    - libpng
    - python
    - h5py * [build=${{ mpi_prefix }}_*]
    - scipy
    - pandas
    - matplotlib-base
    - lxml
    - endf
    - uncertainties
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then: mpi * [build=${{ mpi }}]
    - if: mpi == "openmpi"
      then: openssh
    - ipython
    - njoy2016
    - ncrystal
    - mcpl
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("openmc", upper_bound="x.x") }}


tests:
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - openmc
      include:
        - openmc/*
      lib:
        - openmc
      site_packages:
        - openmc
        - openmc.data
        - openmc.deplete
        - openmc.lib

  - script:
      - openmc --version

  - python:
      imports:
        - openmc
        - openmc.data
        - openmc.deplete
        - openmc.lib
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: OpenMC Monte Carlo Code
  description: |
    OpenMC is a community-developed Monte Carlo neutron and photon transport
    simulation code. It is capable of performing fixed source, k-eigenvalue, and
    subcritical multiplication calculations on models built using either a
    constructive solid geometry or CAD representation. OpenMC supports both
    continuous-energy and multigroup transport. The continuous-energy particle
    interaction data is based on a native HDF5 format that can be generated from
    ACE files produced by NJOY. Parallelism is enabled via a hybrid MPI and
    OpenMP programming model.
  homepage: https://openmc.org
  repository: https://github.com/openmc-dev/openmc
  documentation: https://docs.openmc.org
